visualCharacteristics: Contact tabs shown as a bar above the page on small screens and as fixed side tabs from 1024px whose panel slides out on hover, with a status orb for availability.
contentPattern:
One row per tab: cell 1 the icon notation (e.g. :product-phone:), cell 2 the slide-out panel (

title

+

status line

), cell 3 the short tab label, optional cell 4 a link as tab target. Author it in the first section.
usage: Use once per page in the first section to provide persistent call and chat contact tabs.
reuseGuidance: Reuse the same block on every page that needs contact tabs; use off on pages where the source shows no contact bar.
